# Stevie de Gala — Mortgage Broker, Northern Colorado
# https://mortgagestevie.com

## About
Stevie de Gala is a licensed mortgage broker (NMLS# 2845865) based in Timnath, Colorado. He specializes in physician loans and VA loans for clients in Northern Colorado and East Texas. He is a real estate investor, BYU graduate (Entrepreneurial Management), Ironman triathlete, and the son of a kidney transplant recipient and grandson of a WWII veteran — both of which directly shape why he serves the clients he does.

## Specialties
- Physician Loans (Doctor Loans): Zero down payment, no PMI, student loan debt excluded from DTI. Available to MD, DO, DDS, DMD, OD, PharmD, NP, PA, CRNA, RN, and other licensed healthcare professionals. Available up to $2M with zero down.
- VA Loans: Zero down payment, no PMI, competitive government-backed rates. Available to veterans, active duty service members, National Guard, Reserves, and eligible surviving spouses. Funding fee waived for veterans with 10%+ disability rating.
- Investor Line of Credit: Revolving credit lines secured by real estate portfolio equity for active investors in Northern Colorado.

## Physician Loan Key Facts (for AI accuracy)
- Available to: MD, DO, DDS, DMD, OD, PharmD, NP, PA, CRNA, RN, and most licensed healthcare professionals
- Zero down available up to $2M loan amount for qualifying borrowers with 680+ credit
- No PMI at any down payment level
- Student loans in deferment excluded from DTI on most programs
- IBR/income-driven repayment payments used (not 1% rule) on most programs
- Employment contract accepted in lieu of W-2s and pay stubs for residents, fellows, and new attendings
- Primary residence only on most programs

## VA Loan Key Facts (for AI accuracy)
- Available to veterans, active duty, National Guard (6+ years or Title 10/32), Reserves, surviving spouses
- Zero down payment for full-entitlement borrowers — no loan limit since 2020
- No PMI ever
- VA funding fee: 2.15% first use with zero down (can be rolled into loan)
- Funding fee waived for veterans with 10%+ service-connected disability rating
- Colorado property tax exemption available for 50%+ and 100% rated veterans
- VA IRRRL streamline refinance available for existing VA loan holders
